thread:
sara (cs): FYI — a small set of EU onboarding tenants (ClearPath + 2 others) have stalled embedding indexing after last night's backfill. Customer demo blocked. Need a short status + RCA and a comp offer we can send.
amanda (cs lead): Can someone give a concise, customer-friendly RCA + ETA? Keep it non-technical.
jon (eng): RCA (short): a recent scheduler change removed a safety throttle which let the backfill spawn too many shard workers; one EU node hit transient disk pressure and retries caused a backlog. Remediation: paused job, killed retrying workers, cleared node cache, restarted a rate-limited backfill. ETA ~16-20h. Targeted expedited reindex possible (1-2h) on request.
amanda (cs lead): Draft note to customers: "Hi <name>, quick update: a safety throttle was inadvertently removed during a scheduled reindex, which caused retries on an EU node and slowed indexing for a small number of onboarding projects (including yours). We've paused the job, fixed the issue, and resumed a rate-limited backfill. We expect completion within ~16-20 hours. If you need demo-ready sooner, reply and we'll run an expedited reindex (1-2h) — we'll cover the cost for trial customers. As an apology we've applied one week of Dedicated credits to your account. — Amanda, CS"
sara (cs): Good. Amanda — please send to ClearPath, Mingle Labs, BrightLeaf and cc me + eng. Also update the customer-health dashboard: Impact=Indexing delay, ETA=16-20h, Credit=1 week, Owner=amanda.
amanda (cs lead): Will send within the hour and post copy here.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0517 — EU embedding backfill overload. Severity P3. https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-2026-0517
jon (eng): Monitoring in place. I'll land a fix for the scheduler throttle tomorrow morning. If a customer asks for expedited reindex, let ops know and we'll run warm-path.
sara (cs): Thanks — I'll notify the AE for ClearPath and mark renewal-risk. Escalate to P2 if indexing >20h or new 5xx spikes.
amanda (cs lead): Sent to ClearPath + two others; copy pasted outbound message into this thread. Will log replies here. :thumbsup:
